correctionNotes: Sub-bass rolls off slightly below 40 Hz; a gentle low shelf lift below 30 Hz restores the very lowest octave.
Tame the +2 dB protrusion around 400 Hz to clean up the transition from lower-mids to mid-bass.
Fill the broad 1.5–2.5 kHz presence scoop (centered near 2.1 kHz) to bring vocals and acoustic instrument overtones forward to the Harman target.
Smooth the narrow peaks at 9 kHz and 11 kHz, and the high-treble peak at 16 kHz to remove glare and metallic timbre.
Do not attempt to EQ the deep notch at 9.8 kHz — it is highly likely a coupler reflection/resonance artifact.
signature: Neutral-leaning planar with linear bass matching Harman target down to 40 Hz, elevated mid-bass/lower-mids near 400 Hz, relaxed presence region (1.5-2.5 kHz dip), and energetic treble featuring peaks at 9 kHz, 11 kHz, and 16 kHz.
source: GRAS 43AG-4 measurement by unheardlab.com, user-provided compensated frequency response graph vs Harman OE 2018 Linear Target (screenshot, 2026-06-15).
